title: Armory: Integrations
summary: Stage loadouts with maps, records, storage, power, and recovery support.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Index can describe gear records, Logistics can stage loadouts, PowerGrid can support charging loops, and TutorialCore can point out readiness gaps.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use WorldCore and WeatherCore to predict route pressure, Recovery to plan post-loss returns, and Index or Wiki to compare gear roles before upgrading.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: Without those helpers, keep a written loadout plan: weapon role, shield state, repair stock, food, route, and recovery kit.

blocks.title: Integration Anchor
blocks.body: Use this reference when the related system is present; the manual path still works without it.
